docs: copywriter pass on README + all docs + new AGENTS.md

- README.md: IA reorder (Install moved up; new "What it does (one loop)"
  5-step section; sharper anti-positioning vs agent-memory systems).
- All public docs (walkthrough, glossary, architecture, how-it-works,
  prior-art, tests/README, tests/RESULTS): style normalization, em-dashes
  replaced with colons/periods/parens. No content changes outside README.
- AGENTS.md (new): thin pointer file routing Claude to CLAUDE.md and
  non-Claude agents (Cursor, Codex, Aider, Copilot) to README + the
  canonical skill folder.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The repo now has 17 scenarios (1-17). The greenfield install scenario's
"other 13 scenarios" reference dated to when the suite had 14 total.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs: commit Opus comparison snapshots and lead README with 404/406 aggregate

- Add full-Opus snapshots for the two partial scenarios (01-b2b-churn-opus.json,
  02-inherited-folder-opus.json) as reference data alongside the Sonnet snapshots.
- Lead README + RESULTS.md headline with 404/406 (~99.5%) aggregate, with the
  structural (329/329) vs content (75/77) split as the breakdown.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

scaffold: soften promotion checklist (drop 'defer to pending' escape hatch)

The 4-step promotion checklist added in fd9c9de ended with "if you cannot
complete all four steps, keep the insight at pending-promotion." A 5-run
scenario-02 sweep showed the agent quoted that line verbatim across all 5
runs as justification for refusing to promote — reading it as a higher
evidence threshold, not a format requirement. Net: 0/5 on
insight_promoted_with_dissent vs the snapshot's 1/1, with no offsetting
gain on scenario-01's pre-existing dissent residual.

Re-expressed the same three substantive constraints (count match, dissent
rows, counter-persona surfacing) as bulleted format requirements with
explicit "NOT a higher promotion threshold" framing. Mirrored into
example-brain/CLAUDE.md.

Verification rerun shifted the failure mode from "agent cites scaffold
text" to "agent applies its own 3-signal threshold" — defensible PM
behavior, not a scaffold-prescribed refusal. Pass-rate impact across runs
needs --runs 5 to confirm; documented as such.

Also adds tests/harness/_aggregate_runs.py — re-aggregates already-written
single-run JSONs into per-assertion pass-rate view (what run_all.py does
internally, exposed for ad-hoc analysis).

Full audit trail in docs/testing-decisions.md (2026-05-18 entry).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

harness: retry judge invocations on subprocess flakes (3x w/ backoff)

Three failure signatures from claude -p invocations are not brain-quality signals,
they're harness-environmental — claude_not_found (FileNotFoundError on launch),
timeout, and empty result_text from an otherwise-clean exit. They were being
recorded as UNPARSED → FAIL, indistinguishable in scoreboards from a real model
miss. Confirmed in scenario-02 reruns: 3 of 6 "content fails" were these flakes.

Now wrap run_judge in a 3-attempt retry loop with 1s/3s/8s backoff. Only flake
signatures trigger retry; PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN/UNPARSED-with-content never do
(retrying real model output would mask genuine quality regressions). Every
attempt's cost is tracked. The detail string gets a flake_retries=N(...) tag
when any retry fired, so snapshot readers can still audit noise vs signal.

Cap at 3 attempts: if a launch race or transient throttle hasn't recovered by
attempt 3, attempt 4+ would just pay for more empty calls.

Unit-tested _is_flake_invocation on 8 cases (3 flake shapes + 5 non-flake shapes).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

  16-corrupt-state-recovery, 17-no-artifact-flow

- harness/run_scenario.py + _aggregate_status.py: bootstrap-skip + status agg
- harness/checks/test_hook_validator.py: 13/13 hook unit cases

Validated runs (this session):
- 03-drift-detection: 15/15 structural + 5/5 content ($2.16)
- 14-install-greenfield: 30/30 + 1/1 ($2.04)
- 15-evidence-hierarchy: 19/19 + 2/2 ($1.72)
- 16-corrupt-state-recovery: 15/15 + 2/2 ($0.92)

tests: add 3 commands-coverage scenarios + 8 lifecycle scenarios; harness hardening

Scenarios added since initial commit:
- 02-inherited-folder: bulk-import + tension/staleness/decision lifecycle
- 03-drift-detection: hypothesis demotion on contradicting evidence
- 04-persona-emergence: new-persona proposal from misfit interviews
- 05-stakeholder-cadence: overdue surfacing at /review vs. /decision time
- 06-maintenance-sweep: lossiness analysis + audit-trail preservation
- 07-migration-mode: conservative bulk-ingest from inherited folders
- 08-weekly-review: multi-category surfacing with priority ordering
- 09-ideation: brain-grounded candidates with validation gates
- 10-promotion-gate: 3-signal promotion threshold under mixed evidence
- 11-ingest-shapes: literal /ingest interview|meeting|market|adhoc dispatch
- 12-decision-lifecycle: /prep -> /hypothesize -> /decide chain
- 13-strategic-planning: /strategy-check + /risk + /plan + /ideate quartet

Skill additions (mirrored to example-brain):
- /hypothesize, /decide, /strategy-check command files
- Stricter INDEX.md update + provenance-enum reminders in /hypothesize and /risk
- source/ folder scaffold with .gitkeep + INDEX

Harness:
- structural.py expansions (file_modified_glob, no_orphan_evidence enum check,
  reversal-condition detection, link validation depth-aware)
- content.py with scenario-local rubric override resolution
- rejudge.py utility for replaying judges on saved runs
- Shared judges added (bulk_ingest_caution, staleness_flagged, etc.)
- Scenario-02-local rubric for shared-budgets insight promotion

Docs: testing-decisions.md, README/architecture/how-it-works updates,
schema clarifications around provenance enum + canonical promotion targets.

12 of 13 scenarios pass on single-run sonnet; 02-inherited-folder lands
at content 0.73 (below 0.8 threshold) due to persistent agent gaps on
dissent preservation and provenance-enum compliance in long-state runs.
